research_questions.question: Why do users repeatedly buy from the same categories? Is it convenience, trust, or lack of awareness?

research_questions.label: Exploration Barriers

research_questions.semantic_query: I wanted to try the pet food or beauty section but I was not sure about the quality or price. Ended up not buying.

research_questions.label: Discovery Pathways
research_questions.question: How do users currently discover products or categories they were not already buying?
research_questions.semantic_query: I discovered a new product because of a recommendation or offer and it became something I buy regularly now.

research_questions.label: Role of Habit
research_questions.question: How strongly do established routines suppress willingness to experiment with new categories?
research_questions.semantic_query: I have a fixed list I order every time. I don't really look at other sections because my list is already set.

research_questions.label: Information Needs
